title: STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.19214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. translated_title: STaSBO：面向贝叶斯优化的LLM引导策略规划与配置选择
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）能够对昂贵的黑盒问题进行样本高效的搜索，但其性能在很大程度上取决于代理模型-采集函数配置，而这些配置的适用性会随问题和优化状态的不同而变化。我们通过STaSBO在LLM驱动的贝叶斯优化战略管理方面迈出了重要一步。STaSBO是一个任务无关的元控制器，它负责规划搜索行为并联合选择代理模型-采集函数配置，同时数值型贝叶斯优化仍然保留概率建模与候选点生成的职责。STaSBO由两个相互协调的阶段组成：策略规划和策略引导的配置选择。一个结构化记忆系统将先前的计划、配置选择和候选行为与优化状态相关联，使控制器能够在规划过程中修正其轨迹摘要和行为计划。为了在庞大的联合配置空间中进行导航，选择阶段会先筛选出……
tldr: STaSBO提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的任务无关元控制器，通过策略规划与策略引导的配置选择两个协调阶段，动态管理贝叶斯优化的搜索行为及代理模型-采集函数配置，同时保留数值贝叶斯优化进行概率建模和候选点生成的职责。
en_tdlr: STaSBO is an LLM-driven, task-agnostic meta-controller that coordinates strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection to dynamically manage Bayesian optimization search behavior and surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains probabilistic modeling and candidate generation.
